episode.title: Retry transient compaction and branch-summary failures under the configured retry budget
episode.before: At parent 4b91ec66fd33026e6e44a0dca5a954a59abd3ee9, compaction, split-turn summarization, and branch summarization each issued one assistant completion request. A transient stream or transport error such as "terminated" immediately failed the summarization and therefore the enclosing context-compaction or branch-navigation operation. Existing assistant-turn retry settings were not applied to these internal summarization requests, and no summarization-specific retry lifecycle events were exposed.
episode.after: At merge commit 65dd2e0ed6c71bd61d698353c29f2de24968bf76, all compaction and branch-summary completion paths pass through a reusable bounded retry operation. It applies the configured retry policy only to errors classified as transient, uses exponential backoff, stops at maxRetries, returns quota/billing and abort outcomes without retrying, and normalizes cancellation during backoff to an aborted assistant response. Coding-agent sessions and the reusable agent harness pass retry policy and callbacks into summarization, emit operation-aware retry lifecycle events, and update interactive retry indicators. Tests cover recovery, exhaustion, disabled policy, non-retryable errors, event ordering, and cancellation during backoff.
episode.diff: The change added RetryPolicy, RetryCallbacks, abort-aware backoff, and retryAssistantCall to the AI utility layer; replaced direct single-shot completion calls in compaction, split-turn, and branch-summary paths with retry-wrapped completion choke points; threaded retry settings and callbacks from coding-agent sessions and AgentHarness call sites; added typed retry lifecycle events and interactive status handling; and added unit, harness, and issue-specific regression tests. The first-parent diff contains 916 insertions and 27 deletions across 16 files.

evidence_units.claim: The pinned merge commit resolves PR #6901 with the stated purpose "compaction & branch summarization follow retry policy" and has first parent 4b91ec66fd33026e6e44a0dca5a954a59abd3ee9.
evidence_units.source: git show --format=fuller 65dd2e0ed6c71bd61d698353c29f2de24968bf76; issue-bundle.json resolved_commit, parent_commit, and commit_show_stat

evidence_units.claim: Before the change, coding-agent completeSummarization directly invoked completeSimple or streamFn(...).result() once, with no retry policy or callbacks.

retryAssistantCall performs an initial call plus at most maxRetries transient-error retries, with exponential delay baseDelayMs * 2^(attempt-1), and emits scheduled, attempt-start, and finished callbacks.

The retry operation returns successful and non-retryable responses immediately, never retries an aborted response, and converts cancellation during retry sleep into an AssistantMessage with stopReason "aborted".

Transient classification includes transport, connection, timeout, server, rate-limit, premature-stream, and explicit retry-guidance errors, while quota, billing, budget, and subscription-limit errors are explicitly excluded.

Coding-agent routes history summaries, split-turn prefix summaries, and branch summaries through completeSummarization, which wraps either the configured stream function or simple completion with retryAssistantCall.

AgentSession supplies settingsManager.getRetrySettings() for manual, threshold, and overflow compaction and for branch summarization, and supplies callbacks carrying compaction reason or branch-summary source.
evidence_units.source: 65dd2e0ed6c71bd61d698353c29f2de24968bf76:packages/coding-agent/src/core/agent-session.ts, compact call sites, branch-summary call site, and _summarizationRetryCallbacks

evidence_units.claim: AgentHarness accepts an optional RetryPolicy, passes it to compaction and branch-summary generation, and maps retry callbacks to operation-tagged harness events.

Coding-agent exposes summarization_retry_scheduled, summarization_retry_attempt_start, and summarization_retry_finished events; interactive mode uses them to show the error/backoff state and restore the underlying compaction or branch-summary indicator when a retry begins.

Retry utility tests assert immediate success, terminal aborts, fail-fast quota errors, bounded exhaustion, recovery before exhaustion, disabled policy, callback ordering, and cancellation during backoff.
AgentHarness tests assert transient compaction and branch-summary recovery with operation-tagged lifecycle events, no retry for insufficient_quota, and final failure after the configured retry count.

The #6647 regression test drives real session compaction through a scripted stream and verifies recovery after transient "terminated" errors, no retry for insufficient_quota or disabled policy, bounded exhaustion, retry event emission, and abortCompaction cancelling a backoff.

The first-parent merge diff changes 16 files with 916 insertions and 27 deletions, spanning retry utilities, both summarization implementations, session and harness call sites, event documentation, UI handling, and tests.

The regression oracle defines successful resolution as preserving compaction completion after retryable stream drops while retaining immediate failure for deterministic errors, honoring retry bounds, and remaining cancellable during backoff.

candidate_atomics.name: retry-transient-assistant-operation-with-bounded-backoff
candidate_atomics.description: Wrap one assistant-producing operation in policy-controlled retries that distinguish transient failures from terminal errors and remain cancellable during backoff.

semantic_action.intent: Allow a state-preserving internal model operation to recover from temporary provider or transport failure without retrying deterministic failures indefinitely.
semantic_action.pre_state: An assistant-producing operation can return success, abort, a deterministic error, or an error classified as transient; an optional retry policy and cancellation signal are available.
semantic_action.post_state: Success and deterministic terminal outcomes return immediately; transient errors are retried no more than the configured budget with exponential backoff; cancellation terminates both requests and backoff in a uniform aborted result.
semantic_action.validation: Unit tests verify call counts, retry bounds, error classification, callback ordering, recovery, exhaustion, disabled policy, and abort behavior.

candidate_atomics.name: apply-retry-policy-to-context-summarization-boundaries
candidate_atomics.description: Route every compaction and branch-summary model request through the same retry-aware completion boundary and propagate policy from owning sessions or harnesses.

semantic_action.intent: Prevent a transient summarization stream failure from aborting context compaction or branch navigation on the first failed request.
semantic_action.pre_state: Compaction, split-turn, and branch-summary paths issue single-shot model requests even though the enclosing session or harness has retry configuration.
semantic_action.post_state: All summarization request variants use the shared retry operation with the caller's configured policy and preserve existing request functions, signals, prompts, and result handling.
semantic_action.validation: Harness and coding-agent regression tests inject transient failures into compaction and branch summarization, then assert recovery, bounded failure, disabled-policy behavior, and non-retryable failure behavior.

candidate_atomics.name: publish-summarization-retry-lifecycle
candidate_atomics.description: Expose retry scheduling, attempt restart, and completion so API consumers and interactive interfaces can represent a delayed summarization operation accurately.

semantic_action.intent: Keep observers informed while a compaction or branch-summary operation temporarily leaves its normal active state for retry backoff.
semantic_action.pre_state: Retrying an internal summarization request changes timing and status, but consumers cannot distinguish backoff, restarted execution, and retry-loop completion.
semantic_action.post_state: Observers receive typed lifecycle events containing retry progress and operation context; interactive presentation shows retry status and restores the correct underlying activity indicator when the next attempt starts.
semantic_action.validation: Harness tests assert ordered operation-tagged events, regression tests assert scheduled and finished event counts, and event handlers cover scheduled, attempt-start, and finished variants.

candidate_workflows.name: make-context-reduction-resilient-to-transient-stream-failures
candidate_workflows.description: Introduce bounded, cancellable retry behavior at the shared summarization boundary, propagate the existing policy through every context-reduction call path, and expose the retry lifecycle without retrying deterministic failures.

workflow_graph.goal: Compaction and branch summarization survive retryable provider or transport interruptions while remaining bounded, cancellable, observable, and fail-fast for deterministic errors.
workflow_graph.entry_state: Context-reduction model calls are single-shot even when their owning runtime already has retry settings, so a transient stream drop aborts the enclosing operation.
workflow_graph.exit_state: Every context-reduction request shares a classified bounded-retry boundary; retry policy and cancellation flow from the owning runtime; observers can track retry state; success, exhaustion, deterministic errors, disabled retry, and cancellation have explicit test oracles.
